candidates.titulo: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password
candidates.resumen: The new feature allows agents to log into a customer's personal accounts while still protecting the private credentials that secure those accounts.

candidates.resumen: The ride-share giant previously deployed a much smaller pilot for ChatGPT Work but is now taking the enterprise agent company-wide.

candidates.titulo: Claude Duet app is Anthropic’s bet on agents
candidates.resumen: Claude Duet is available through waitlist for Pro and Max plan users.

candidates.titulo: Canva’s first AI image model plans designs before generating them
candidates.resumen:
Canva is diving even deeper into AI with the launch of an image generation model that competes directly with those from OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google. The model, called Canva Craft, uses a two-stage architecture that allows it to plan a design before generating an image, allowing for "greater precision, consistency and control," according to an announcement on Thursday.
